correctness.rationale: Necessity: the failure-length set is closed under addition by persistent witness addition and cannot contain 1. Sufficiency: every additive monoid in N0 is finitely generated; assign each positive generator d to infinitely many separated integer-scale blocks {G_j,-(d-1)G_j}; only 0 persists, and for each fixed h the least nonzero coefficient modulo G_{j+1} proves zero representability iff h lies in the monoid. The trivial monoid has positive-tail witness. Independently enumerated 38 finite small cases in VERIFY.py; no inference from experiment to all h.

value.rationale: The characterization completely determines the exact spectra possible under a natural empty-core condition in the fixed ambient additive group Z; it converts the problem to a structural monoid criterion with an explicit simultaneous realization for each monoid. It includes novel multi-generator monoid spectra beyond the known single-d examples, exhibits forbidden spectrum shapes via a necessary algebraic closure condition, and identifies the boundary with nonempty-core/global arbitrary-semigroup results. It is a meaningful natural complete classification rather than a routine finite computation.
